notes: Class XII theory: Time 3 Hours, Total Marks 70; practical 30 (Volumetric Analysis 08, Salt Analysis 08, Content Based Experiment 06, Project Work 04, Class record and viva 04).

Each unit is printed as one comma-separated list of (NCERT section) topics with no chapter level, so each unit has one chapter repeating the unit title and topics[] = the comma-separated items as printed (protected phrases where a comma is inside one item, e.g. 'Relationship between Equilibrium Constant K, Reaction Quotient Q and Gibbs Energy G').
Question paper design: 'No chapter wise weightage is provided, however, care to be taken to cover all the chapters.' — the per-unit marks are those printed in the course-structure table.

Qualitative-analysis cation/anion lists in the practical syllabus are typeset in bold math-italic (non-BMP) characters, e.g. '𝑷𝒃𝟐+'; they are copied verbatim, with charges flattened onto the line as the text layer gives them (Pb²⁺ reads 'Pb2+', CO₃²⁻ reads 'CO3 2−'). (Main-thread fix 2026-10-12: an earlier decoding turned these into U+FFFD and dropped them.)
Practicals: the main practical syllabus only (sections A-F/K + suggested projects); the reduced list for visually challenged students is not copied.
FORMATIVE-ONLY units: 'Surface Chemistry', 'General Principles and Processes of Isolation of Elements', 'Polymers', 'Chemistry in Everyday life' (formativeOnly: true, no marks).
Verbatim source typos kept, e.g. 'Physical Propeties', 'Chemical Reactions Chemical Reactions Importance of Diazonium Salts'.

practicals.heading: A. Surface Chemistry
items: 1. Preparation of one lyophilic and one lyophobic sol Lyophilic sol - starch, egg albumin and gum Lyophobic sol – aluminum hydroxide, ferric hydroxide, arsenous sulphide.
2. Dialysis of sol-prepared in (a) above.
3. Study of the role of emulsifying agents in stabilizing the emulsion of different oils.

practicals.heading: B.Chemical Kinetics
items: 1. Effect of concentration and temperature on the rate of reaction between Sodium Thiosulphate and Hydrochloric acid.
2. Study of reaction rates of any one of the following:
Reaction of Iodide ion with Hydrogen Peroxide at room temperature using different concentration of Iodide ions.
Reaction between Potassium Iodate, (KIO3) and Sodium Sulphate: (Na2SO3) using starch solution as indicator (clock reaction).

practicals.heading: C.Thermochemistry
items: Any one of the following experiments
Enthalpy of dissolution of Copper Sulphate or Potassium Nitrate.
Enthalpy of neutralization of strong acid (HCI) and strong base (NaOH).
Determination of enthalpy change during interaction (Hydrogen bond formation) between Acetone and Chloroform.

practicals.heading: D.Electrochemistry
items: Variation of cell potential in Zn/Zn2+|| Cu2+/Cu with change in concentration of electrolytes (CuSO4 or ZnSO4) at room temperature.

practicals.heading: E. Chromatography
items: 1. Separation of pigments from extracts of leaves and flowers by paper chromatography and determination of Rf values.
2. Separation of constituents present in an inorganic mixture containing two cations only (constituents having large difference in Rf values to be provided).

practicals.heading: F. Preparation of Inorganic Compounds
items: 1. Preparation of double salt of Ferrous Ammonium Sulphate or Potash Alum.
2. Preparation of Potassium Ferric Oxalate.

practicals.heading: G.Preparation of Organic Compounds
items: Preparation of any one of the following compounds
1. Acetanilide
2. Di –benzal acetone
3. p-Nitroacetanilide
4. Aniline yellow or 2 - Naphthol Aniline dye.

practicals.heading: H.Tests for the functional groups present in organic compounds
items: Unsaturation, alcoholic, phenolic, aldehydic, ketonic, carboxylic and amino (Primary) groups.

practicals.heading: I. Characteristic tests of carbohydrates, fats and proteins in pure samples and their detection in given foodstuffs.
J. Determination of concentration/ molarity of KMnO4 solution by titrating it against a standard solution of:
items: 1. Oxalic acid,
2. Ferrous Ammonium Sulphate (Students will be required to prepare standard solutions by weighing themselves).

practicals.heading: K.Qualitative analysis

Anions: 𝑪𝑶𝟑 𝟐−,𝐒𝟐− , 𝐒𝐎𝟑 𝟐−, 𝑵𝑶𝟑 −, 𝑵𝑶𝟐 − , 𝐂𝐥−, 𝐁𝐫−, 𝐈− ,𝑺𝑶𝟒 𝟐−, 𝑷𝑶𝟒 𝟑− , 𝐂𝐇𝟑 𝐂𝐎𝐎−, C2O42- (Note: Insoluble salts excluded)

practicals.heading: PROJECTS
items: Scientific investigations involving laboratory testing and collecting information from other sources. A few suggested Projects
a) Study of the presence of oxalate ions in guava fruit at different stages of ripening.
b) Study of quantity of casein present in different samples of milk.
c) Preparation of soybean milk and its comparison with the natural milk with respect to curd formation, effect of temperature, etc.
d) Study of the effect of Potassium Bisulphate as food preservative under various conditions (temperature, concentration, time, etc.)
e) Study of digestion of starch by salivary amylase and effect of pH and temperature on it.
f) Comparative study of the rate of fermentation of following materials: wheat flour, gram flour, potato juice, carrot juice, etc.
g) Extraction of essential oils present in Saunf (aniseed), Ajwain (carom), Illaichi (cardamom).
h) Study of common food adulterants in fat, oil, butter, sugar, turmeric power, chili powder and pepper.
